title: CsTotemSound
description: This resource pack replaces the totem popping sound with the iconic CS2 headshot sound.
body:
CSTotemSound replaces the default Minecraft Totem of Undying activation sound with the high-fidelity headshot sound effect from Counter-Strike 2. This resource pack is designed for players who prioritize competitive audio cues and desire a cleaner, more responsive auditory experience during high-stakes PvP encounters.
Features
High-Fidelity Audio: Replaces the vanilla totem "pop" with the iconic, crisp CS2 headshot audio.
Competitive Clarity: The sharper sound profile provides clearer feedback during intense combat, ensuring you never miss the moment your totem triggers.
Optimized Performance: A lightweight, sound-only resource pack that guarantees zero impact on your game's FPS or performance.
Vanilla-Friendly Integration: Designed to feel seamless within the existing Minecraft audio environment while maintaining a distinct, modern aesthetic.
Technical Specifications
Format: Sound-only resource pack.
Compatibility: Fully compatible with all major versions. No external mods are required.
Installation:
Download the .zip file.
Open your Minecraft resourcepacks folder.
Drag and drop the file into the folder.
Activate the pack in your in-game Resource Pack menu.
Enjoy ;D
